_description: Tool registry for Weaver Write — each tool has a unified run() interface
_note: The system reads this registry and matches triggers against the task, exactly as Claude reads its tool descriptions. Triggers are bilingual (AR+EN).

tools.name: academic_search
tools.description: Academic RAG search with page-accurate citations via PaperQA2. Fetches studies from Semantic Scholar/CrossRef/OpenAlex/arXiv and answers with (Author, Year, p. X) citations.

tools.name: web_extract
tools.description: Clean web page text extraction via Trafilatura/UniWeb. Strips ads and menus, returns the article text only.

tools.name: doc_read
tools.description: Read and extract text from PDF/DOCX/image files with page numbers, plus OCR for scanned files via UniDoc/Tesseract.

tools.name: credibility_check
tools.description: Assess academic source credibility via PaperQA2 clients: journal quality, retraction status, author metadata.

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: Store and retrieve task references in isolated memory via UniMemory with truth-check.

tools.name: doc_export
tools.description: Generate the final file as DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/PDF with Arabic RTL support and citations.

tools.name: word
tools.description: Build or read Word (.docx) files with RTL support. Build via docx/python-docx, read via markitdown/pandoc/mammoth.

tools.name: powerpoint
tools.description: Build or read PowerPoint (.pptx) files. Build via pptxgenjs/python-pptx, read via markitdown.

tools.name: excel
tools.description: Build, read, or edit Excel (.xlsx) files with formulas and formatting via openpyxl/pandas.

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Read PDF text/tables, OCR scanned PDFs (no GPU), or build/merge PDFs. Via pdfplumber/pdf2image/pytesseract/pypdf.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web via a SearXNG meta-search instance; returns ranked results from many engines. Discovers sources (vs web_extract which reads one URL).

tools.name: diagram
tools.description: Render a diagram (flowchart, sequence, gantt, ER, mindmap) from Mermaid syntax to SVG/PNG.

tools.name: mcp_connector
tools.description: Access bundled MCP servers: filesystem (sandboxed files), git (versioning), time (timezone timestamps).

tools.name: csv
tools.description: Read, write, and clean CSV/TSV data files for research datasets and tables.

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Create or read iCalendar (.ics) files for research timelines, deadlines, and milestones.

tools.name: scheduler
tools.description: Schedule tasks to run later or on an interval (deferred generation, periodic re-checks).

tools.name: chart
tools.description: Render themed statistical charts (12 types) and embed them into Word/PowerPoint files.

tools.name: web_document
tools.description: Download a document from a URL and read it (HTML/PDF/scanned-PDF/image) with automatic OCR. Bridges web discovery to document reading.

tools.name: youtube
tools.description: Fetch a YouTube video's transcript (ready-made captions) to summarize it or reproduce it verbatim. Text transcript only — no audio download or speech-to-text.
